'''Halduron Brightwing''' is the current Ranger-General of the [[Silvermoon Remnant]], having succeeded [[Damilara Sunsorrow]]. The foremost hunter among the remaining Quel'dorei, Halduron leads the forces stationed at [[Last Runestone|the Last Runestone]] holding back the undead trying to penetrate the [[Thalassian Highlands]] through [[Scourged Pass|the Scourged Pass]].

==Quests==
* {{questlong|Alliance|10|Taming the Beast (high elf 4)|Taming the Beast|class=hunter|race=HighElf}} {{questfinish}}

==Quotes==
Once, in the echoes of time that now feels like a distant fantasy, I dreamed of donning the mantle of Ranger-General. A vision painted with the vibrant hues of ambition danced before my eyes. Yet, the years have woven a different tapestry, one marked by the harsh brushstrokes of reality.

The coveted title, once a beacon of achievement, has transformed into a weighty burden resting heavily upon these weathered shoulders of mine.
